}}'''Filger''' is a scout in the [[Band of the Red Hand]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Filger}}

== Appearance ==
He is lean with thinning hair.

== Activities ==
He sends word to [[Talmanes Delovinde]] that the troops holding the gate inside [[Caemlyn]] are about to be overrun by [[Trolloc]]s. He then continues to fight with Talamanes force and reports of another Trolloc army moving on their rear after they find [[Aludra]]'s [[Dragons]].

==Trivia==
*Filger is named after Jacob Figler, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
